p: Wellington Place is in the heart of the modern town centre, a few minutes from Hastings station and right by Priory Meadow shopping centre, so this branch suits anyone arriving by train or killing time in town. It's an adult gaming centre, open to over 18s only.

From here the seafront is a short stroll downhill, and it's well worth the walk. Keep heading east along the front to reach the Old Town, with its timber-framed houses, independent shops and pubs along George Street and the High Street. Down at the far end of the front, the fishing boats sit right on the shingle beach. If you'd rather stay green, Alexandra Park is a lovely long stretch of lakes and woodland back up behind the town.
